items.en: Choose which page Semestra opens on, including where you left off.
items.zh: 可以设置打开 Semestra 时显示的页面，包括上次离开的页面。

items.en: The sidebar now holds the current term's pages and courses, with a term switcher above them; term pages no longer have a tab bar.
items.zh: 侧边栏改为当前学期的工作区，直接列出学期页面与课程，并可在顶部切换学期；学期页面不再显示标签栏。

items.en: Cards make better use of their space: small cards drop the title row, long lists fade at the edge to show they scroll, and schedule entries open with a click.
items.zh: 卡片更充分地利用空间：小卡片不再占用标题行，长列表在边缘渐隐提示可以滚动，课表条目点一下即可打开。

items.en: Read a course's details from a file such as its syllabus in the course settings: pick a file, check the changes, apply.
items.zh: 在课程设置里从文件识别课程信息：选一个文件，核对变化后应用。

items.en: Clearer GPA cards: the overview adds a GPA bar for each term, and the charts line up across terms.
items.zh: GPA 卡片更清晰：概览新增各学期的 GPA 条，图表在各学期之间对齐。

items.en: The week card now shows the coming days starting from yesterday, sized to fit your classes.
items.zh: 本周课表卡片改为显示从昨天起的近几日课表，时间范围按课程自动适配。

items.en: The course schedule is reorganized into weekly meetings, one-off events and cancellations, sections can be switched on or off as a whole, and you can now cancel or move a single class from it.
items.zh: 课程课表按每周上课时间、单次事件和停课与调课重新整理，可按教学班整体开关，并可直接停课或调课。

items.en: Task lists are shown in a column on the Tasks page instead of the sidebar.
items.zh: 待办列表移到待办页面左侧，不再在侧边栏中展开。

items.en: Upload files from a term's Files page by choosing a course or dropping them on its section, and drop files on a folder to upload into it.
items.zh: 学期的文件页可以选择课程上传，或把文件拖到课程分组上；文件也可以直接拖进文件夹。

items.en: The habit calendar is now part of the habit card: check in on the ring and review past weeks beside it. Existing calendar cards are converted automatically.
items.zh: 习惯日历并入习惯打卡卡片：在圆环上打卡，旁边回顾最近几周的记录；已有的日历卡片会自动转换。

items.en: Fixed the last characters of an edited message sometimes being dropped when it was sent with Enter.
items.zh: 修复编辑消息后按 Enter 发送时，偶尔丢失最后几个字符的问题。

items.en: Fixed a stray horizontal scrollbar under the file list.
items.zh: 修复文件列表下方多出的横向滚动条。

items.en: Reading a syllabus with Claude models works again, and is faster: course info, grading and schedule are read side by side.
items.zh: 用 Claude 模型识别课程大纲不再报错，而且更快：课程信息、成绩构成和课表同时识别。
